activation.note: consentKey and its values are the APPROVED DESIGN's own contract (home view logic writes localStorage['ktahv-consent'] = accepted|declined). The site-wide notice reuses the same key so one choice covers every page.

verification._comment: Ownership proof, not tracking: these carry no cookies and are NOT consent-gated. They matter at the DNS flip — if they are missing when the domain moves, Search Console and Bing verification break.
